I went ahead and completed all but just 2 achievements, and I can honestly say that each massage was indeed unique. My least favorite massage was from the Navi, and my all-time favorite was the out of this world massage from Janein.

Perks of this game
1.It will have you laughing your ass off each and every single date. Some are just plain hilarious and unexpected, while other's are just really well made as far as humor goes.

2. At least for me, the out of this world massage is just worth the price alone. I set my xbox 360 controller on my lower back, and just let it massage me for 20-30 minutes straight. Maybe it's because I'm an author and I sit too much, but that massage just feels amazing and leaves my back pain-free for hours at a time. I 3-starred her on the first go as well. It will be different for each person, but with 10 different massages, at least one will hit the right spot.

Disadvantages
1. It does require a specific set of controllers to function at 100% that are obviously not included.. The massages are a major part of the game, but you aren't really paying the price it would require to have a controller included anyway. I could see the game at 60$ with it's own messaging devices included, but for the price, you can afford to buy a corded gaming controller, steam, ps4, xbox all work.

Neutral
1. It is rather short, as in it can be completed quickly if you take it seriously, but that also means that you can unlock all of the girls rather quickly. I found my perfect massage early on, but that may not be the case with everyone.
